note: What has been improved in the atlas, newest first, one plain headline each. Hand-written, because a changelog read off the commit log says what a developer did and not what a reader can now do. The home page shows the latest five and /whats-new/ shows all of them. Add an entry when a change a visitor can see goes live, not when it is merged. date is YYYY-MM-DD; href is a path inside the atlas (starting with /) or omitted.
